name: Infosys Ltd
about: Infosys Ltd provides consulting, technology, outsourcing and next-generation digital services to enable clients to execute strategies for their digital transformation. It is the 2nd largest Information Technology company in India behind TCS.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year -on-year in constant currency terms.
items.actual: Guidance now 1% to 2% after two cuts
items.why: Cut to 1.5% to 3% in July and to 1% to 2% in October, so the top of the original range is now out of reach.
items.actual_quote: Based on our Q2 performance and revised outlook for rest of the year, our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY .in constant currency terms.

items.quote: Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
items.why: Reaffirmed in both later calls while the revenue guidance was cut twice.
items.actual_quote: Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.

bull.text: Revenue has compounded 12.2% a year over 5 years
Profits turn into cash: operating cash flow was 115% of PAT over 3 years

bear.text: FY27 revenue growth, constant currency: promised 1.5% to 3.5%, got Guidance now 1% to 2% after two cuts
Growth is slowing: revenue 6.8% a year over 3 years vs 12.2% over 5

claims.summary: The prepared remarks on the latest calls had no whole-company figures to check; management spoke in segment numbers.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 115% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 72 days to pay, against 63 three years ago. Sales may be booked faster than cash is collected.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 7% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 10% while operating profit grew 8%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 29%, against 27% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.09× equity, against 0.09× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 13.9%, down 0.4 points over the last 4 reported quarters.

quality.summary: 7 of 8 checks are clean; look at: customers pay on time.
